company.name: UXD Protocol
company.shortDescription: UXD Protocol is a decentralized stablecoin protocol on the Solana blockchain that uses delta-neutral strategies.
company.description: UXD Protocol is a decentralized finance (DeFi) platform that issues the UXD stablecoin, a fully collateralized digital asset designed to maintain a stable value through delta-neutral trading strategies and low-volatility yield-generating positions. Built on the Solana blockchain, the protocol integrates with derivative exchanges and lending markets to create capital-efficient and decentralized stablecoin infrastructure. UXD aims to solve the “stablecoin trilemma” by balancing stability, decentralization, and capital efficiency while also providing native yield opportunities for users. The protocol is governed through the UXP governance token and focuses on transparent, non-custodial financial operations within the Web3 ecosystem.
